name: use_app
description: Is the user asking to open, launch, or switch to an application?

name: speak_time
description: Is the user asking what the time is?

name: open_url
description: Is the user asking to open a saved website such as email, YouTube, GitHub, or Wikipedia?

name: set_volume
description: Is the user asking to change the volume?

name: take_screenshot
description: Is the user asking to take a screenshot?

name: toggle_dark_mode
description: Is the user asking to switch between light and dark mode?

name: quit_app
description: Is the user asking to quit or close an application?

name: lock_screen
description: Is the user asking to lock the screen?

name: browser_snapshot
description: Is the user asking to list the controls on the current web page?

name: browser_read
description: Is the user asking to read the text of a numbered control on the current web page?

name: browser_click
description: Is the user asking to click a numbered control on the current web page?

name: browser_submit
description: Is the user asking to submit a form or send a message through a numbered control on the current web page?

name: browser_search
description: Is the user asking to search Google, GitHub, YouTube, Wikipedia, or Stack Overflow for something?

name: run_skill
description: Is the user asking for a skill — a fixed multi-step procedure such as finding and opening a file, composing a mail with an attachment, creating a calendar event, or taking a screenshot?

name: navigate_tab
description: Is the user asking to open a new tab in a browser?

name: close_tab
description: Is the user asking to close the current browser tab?
